description: The HYPE holder leaderboard: each wallet's spot HYPE balance plus staked HYPE, largest first, valued at one current HYPE price, with its `pnl_cohort` resolved at query time (`label_basis` is `current`; balances are last-known, so a stale balance can sit beside a fresh label) and `account_value`, the wallet's perp account value in USD (null for a holder with no perp account on record, never 0). Keyset-paged with `cursor`. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/hype/holders.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page.

name: hl_hype_holders
